title: Search an optional closed PR corpus with explicit overlap coverage
body:
The overlap helper currently searches remote open PRs and represents closed work only through local notes and the ledger. Add opt-in `--include-closed` coverage for every page of closed/merged PR titles and bodies, with its own cache and coverage timestamp. Default searches keep their existing remote scope and request count.

Open and closed snapshots can straddle a state change. The combined corpus keeps one record per PR number using the newest GitHub update time (open wins an exact tie), while retaining both coverage timestamps. A failed paginated refresh preserves the previous complete corpus and emits a warning; a missing corpus remains explicitly missing. Closed-PR changed-file coverage is not implemented, so combining the option with `--path` fails before any fetch.

Validation: 15 focused overlap tests and 24 onboarding tests pass on CPython 3.12.7 / Windows. Eight new tests cover later-page matches, default isolation, missing offline coverage, first/later fetch failures, state changes, an empty complete corpus and the unsupported path combination. A live opt-in run fetched 1,621 closed PRs with complete pagination at 2026-10-15 17:22:49 UTC. An exact historical query returned PR2063 once in closed state despite its presence in the older open snapshot. No code-diff or unpublished-work coverage is implied.

Started from canonical main `8513ab11936831dc45305170357ce6d33098e4e5`, priority revision 5; checked compatible with main `b5ea56e0a5ac4552166253b1fa4be0753bb38c30`, which changes none of these three files. Selection seed `2859fcc88b788a34d5fb9ed6a76547b8` initially suggested a bit-mechanism card; scope changed to this bounded overlap-tooling gap after the mechanism overlap screen. Baseline source bindings passed. The live refresh at 17:35:58 UTC covered 786 open PRs; Discussion refresh hit the GraphQL rate limit and retained the explicitly dated 1,303-record snapshot from 16:54:03 UTC. Related PR2514 handles Discussion batching and PR2154 package-root terms, not this closed-body corpus. This is tooling only; frozen research, priorities and the selected result are unchanged.

A separate Codex agent reviewed the exact commit, exported it from Git and independently passed all 15 overlap and 24 onboarding tests under CPython 3.12.14. No blocking findings. A bounded live check of the latest 100 updated PRs at 17:48:43 UTC found no competing closed-corpus change; that check supplements the declared full snapshots and does not claim a complete new Discussion refresh. The final canonical-main fetch returned `6bd33bc0b87a01e9c9d8b1c01576f3ddbcaee850`; its 283 changed files leave AGENTS, autoresearch, family guidance, selected record and all three contribution files unchanged. The reviewed contribution remains on its stated base.

Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
